Arc contract: 25 rules across 13 Arcs, with 125 exact-rank bindings verified.

Arc presentation trigger keys (EN and FR): healing, redirect_skill, redirect_skill_or_enter_combat, redirect_skill_or_ultimate, three_followup_hits_after_ultimate_or_enter_combat, ultimate, ultimate_control, wearer_deals_chaos_damage, wearer_deals_damage_over_time, wearer_deals_incantation_damage.
Arc event confirmations represent an active window or selected stack count. Native activation, refresh, mixed-source precedence and unrepresented action or target filters require separate support.
Arc projections marked legacy_conditional_projection replace the matching legacy stat once. Migration details are in docs/signature-arc-coverage.md.

Arc scope wearer_filtered_damage requires per-hit support. requires_any_damage_tags match by equality or a dot-delimited descendant. Apply each rule once per hit. requires_damage_tags still requires every listed tag.
Arc stack_input fixed_stack_count multiplies the rank parameter by the verified fixed_stacks grant on confirmation. This input has no stack-count selector.
Arc superseded_by_trigger requires consumer support. Suppress the selected stack rule when the named trigger is confirmed on that Arc, so the fixed grant fills their shared pool once.
Ravenous Blade uses only its selected stack count. The old max-stack CritDamageBase rows are absent in this catalog.
Ready-Ready uses one selected active stack count for both damage filters on the same wearer and Arc.
Dotted Horizon snapshot contract: dotted_horizon_wearer_summon_stacks uses wearer_summon_damage. Earlier snapshots can use a different ID and scope.
